caption: The drawing depicts the head of a stylized bird, possibly an eagle, oriented to the left side of the image. The bird has a prominent black beak with a sharp curve at the tip and a red interior visible at the open mouth. The top of the bird’s head is colored white, while the area around the eye and the side of the head are yellow. The eye is round and features a red ring around the black pupil. Decorative patterns are present on the back of the head, consisting of alternating sections of red, white, and black arranged in a diamond pattern. There are also yellow scroll-like elements at the rear end, giving the appearance of carved or sculpted detail. The neck region shows a combination of yellow, black, and traces of red and green near the lower edge. The background is plain and light-colored, and there are no additional objects in the image.
title: Billet Head: Eagle
